text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Symboli Rudolf has reclaimed her<n>honor after the
exhibition race, but<n>she has no intention of stopping
here.<n>She sets her sights on the Japan<n>Cup.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
But this time, she isn't putting herself<n>under as
much pressure. She even<n>has enough free time to
enjoy a trip<n>to a teahouse with me.
